outcome: anatomical characteristics of cesarean scar niche
cohort: 100 women with unexplained secondary infertility and a history of at least one cesarean section, showing scar niche in office hysteroscopy
finding: Hysteroscopy and sonohysterography are both useful tools for evaluating cesarean scar niche characteristics, with hysteroscopy considered the gold standard but sonohysterography being a well-tolerated and cost-effective alternative.
